brief:
On the second anniversary of Yahya Sinwar's death in a clash with Israeli forces in Rafah, Shehab Wire examined the Hamas chief's legacy through the lens of the Al-Aqsa Flood operation. Sinwar's experience cannot be understood apart from the profound strategic transformations the October 2023 offensive triggered, the outlet reported.

The scope of those shifts extended beyond immediate military dimensions, according to the account, suggesting Sinwar's tenure reshaped the political and operational landscape in ways that persisted beyond his death in the Gaza conflict.

title: Hamas leader Sinwar shaped strategic shifts that outlast his death
